author: mark
text:
Phase 1: harness root + global/per-repo providers split

Adds the v0.3 layout-migration plumbing without touching the v0.2
dispatch path:

- src/harness_root.rs resolves LERNIE_HOME or ~/.lernie/ (ARCH §2.2).
- src/config/per_repo_providers.rs loads the per-repo 'roles:' section
  (ARCH §4.3) and warns on legacy 'providers:'/'models:' blocks.
- src/config/cross/ splits into per-check modules and adds
  check_roles_against_providers: provider must exist globally, model
  must exist globally and belong to the named provider.
- src/config/mod.rs gains ProvidersConfig::load that loads both halves
  and cross-validates in one call.

Per the Phase 1 scope, the v0.2 template is unchanged (Phase 2's job)
and dispatch keeps reading agents.yaml + per-repo providers.yaml as
before. The new loaders are infrastructure that subsequent phases
wire through.

Gates handled inline:
- Tests: 8 unit (harness_root), 9 unit (per_repo_providers), 5 unit
  (roles_check), 4 integration (ProvidersConfig::load).
- Docs: lib.rs + module doc-comments updated; ARCH §2.2/§4.1/§4.3
  already describe the new shape so no separate doc edit needed.
- Alignment: implementation matches ARCH §4.1 "Two-file config split"
  and §4.3 "Role-based model assignment" verbatim.

make check green, 100% coverage (1369/1369 lines).
